config.history: all strictly earlier exposures from both complete early standard shards; no past outcomes used
config.label_policy: retain publisher binary labels, including invalid-duration rows; is_click has mixed scene semantics
config.metadata_limit: released_user_snapshot is a sensitivity experiment with unknown profile snapshot timing, not leakage-safe evidence
config.checkpoint_selection: minimum inverse-inclusion-weighted validation mean binary log loss
baselines: training tab prevalence with 100 pseudo-exposures of shrinkage
config.readiness_gate: each of 7 objectives: >=20 sampled validation positives, AUC>0.5, logloss and Brier below training global prevalence; development point estimates only

probability_status: sigmoid estimates; calibration measured, not assumed
